name: We Are Riders
summary:
**Welcome to the ride!**

We Are Riders is a multiplayer VR game where you and your friends ride bikes, take on crazy challenges, and compete in mini-games. Pull off insane stunts, crash into each other, and turn every ride into chaos!

**🏍️ Ride With Friends**

 Race through obstacles, perform backflips, or just cruise around together!

**💥 Mess With Your Friends**

Punch them, blow them up, knock them off their bikes, or make their heads swell up. Play nice? Nah!

**🏁 Challenges & Mini-Games**

Compete
